findings.description: Step 11.5 bash fence attempts to execute agent slash command `/audit-choices` inside shell command substitution `$(/audit-choices ...)`. In bash shell execution, `/audit-choices` is evaluated as a root-filesystem binary path rather than an agent sub-agent dispatch, failing immediately with exit code 127 (`No such file or directory`). Consequently, executing this step as shell code always triggers `if ! audit_output=$(...); then`, setting `SKIP_REASON="audit dispatch failed"` and skipping the audit on every run.
findings.resolution: Disambiguate agent sub-agent dispatch from shell execution in Step 11.5 by separating the agent skill invocation from the bash code fence, or execute the driver script directly via `python3 "<skill-base-dir>/../audit-choices/scripts/run_audit.py"` after sub-agent dispatch.

findings.description: Step 11.5 returns immediately when audit dispatch fails or reports a warning (lines 579 and 583), bypassing the partial-pair cleanup block at lines 598-616. If `run_audit.py` or `write_ledger_pair` wrote or modified `choices.json` before warning or failing, returning early leaves an untracked or dirty orphan file on disk in the working tree instead of cleaning it up per F6.
findings.resolution: Move the partial-pair / orphan file cleanup block so it runs unconditionally before returning on audit dispatch failure or warning in `audit_choices_step`.

findings.description: `test_choices_row_in_step_12_report_file_heredoc` checks `assert "$CHOICES_ROW" in section` but fails to assert `"$CHOICES_LINES" in section`. Task 3.2 specified carrying both `$CHOICES_ROW` and `$CHOICES_LINES` into Step 12 persisted heredoc so open decision entry details reach `validation-report.md`. Without asserting `$CHOICES_LINES`, the test would not catch a regression where `$CHOICES_LINES` is omitted from the persisted report.
findings.resolution: Update `test_choices_row_in_step_12_report_file_heredoc` to assert both `"$CHOICES_ROW" in section` and `"$CHOICES_LINES" in section`.
